# BroadSpan Capital

> BroadSpan Capital is an independent investment bank specializing in Latin America and the Caribbean. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Miami, it advises corporations, partnerships and governments on cross-border mergers and acquisitions, financial restructurings, capital raising, and valuations and fairness opinions.

BroadSpan has advised on 168 transactions across four practices:

- Mergers & Acquisitions: 72 transactions
- Financial Restructuring: 30 transactions
- Capital Raising: 19 transactions
- Valuations & Fairness Opinions: 47 transactions

Offices: Miami, Mexico City, Medellín, Caracas, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo. Contact: info@brocap.com, 1441 Brickell Ave, Suite 1550, Miami, FL 33131.

BroadSpan is a member of Mergers Alliance, a partnership of 20 independent corporate finance firms in 24 countries.
BroadSpan Securities LLC is a member of FINRA and SIPC. Asset management activities are conducted through BroadSpan Asset Management LLC.

## Transactions

- [BroadSpan Advises AGS on the Acquisition of A.R. Savage & Son](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-ags-ar-savage.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Agencias Universales (AGS) on the acquisition of 70% of Tampa ship agency A.R. Savage & Son.
- [BroadSpan Advises AGS on the Acquisition of Omni Transloading](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-ags-omni.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Agencias Universales (AGS) on the acquisition of 55% of Omni Transloading & Logistics and Omni Bulk Services.
- [BroadSpan Advises AGUNSA on Acquisition of Carver Maritime Manatee](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-agunsa-carver.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Chile’s AGUNSA on the acquisition of 75% of Carver Maritime Manatee, a Tampa Bay port-logistics operator.
- [BroadSpan Advises ANSA McAL on Acquisition of Bank of Baroda Trinidad](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-ansa-mcal.html): BroadSpan Capital and Mergers Alliance partner Singhi Advisors advised ANSA McAL on its acquisition of 100% of Bank of Baroda (Trinidad and Tobago).
- [BroadSpan Advises on Sale of El Salvador’s Laboratorios Arsal to Costa Rica’s Calox](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-arsal.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Grupo Vargas on the sale of 100% of Laboratorios Arsal to Calox de Costa Rica.
- [BroadSpan Advises the Central Bank of Curaçao and Sint Maarten on the Sale of Banco di Caribe](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-banco-di-caribe.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the Central Bank of Curaçao and Sint Maarten in the sale of 100% of Banco di Caribe to United Group Holdings.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bancolombia on Restructuring of Abengoa Peru Debt](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-bancolombia.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Bancolombia in the settlement of the obligations of ATN3, a 332km transmission project in Peru acquired by Acciona Concesiones.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Belize Sovereign Debt Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-belize-2017.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the Belize Creditors’ Committee in the 2017 restructuring of Belize’s U.S. Dollar Bonds due 2038.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders on Belize Consent Solicitation](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-belize-2020.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the Belize Creditors’ Committee in the 2020 modification of terms of Belize’s U.S. Dollar Bonds due 2034.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bepensa on Acquisition of Crédito Real USA Finance](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-bepensa.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Mexico’s Bepensa on the acquisition of 97.6% of Crédito Real USA Finance in a Section 363 sale.
- [BroadSpan Advises Grupo Boa Praça on Sale of Ship Supply Operations to Wrist Ship Supply](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-boa-praca.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Grupo Boa Praça and its shareholders in the sale of its ship supply operations to Denmark’s Wrist Ship Supply.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Province of Buenos Aires Debt Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-buenos-aires.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as co-financial advisor to the bondholder steering committee in the restructuring of the Province of Buenos Aires’ external debt.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Cap Cana Debt Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-cap-cana.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the bondholder committee in the restructuring of Cap Cana’s 10% Senior Secured Notes and Recovery Notes.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Puerto Rico COFINA Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-cofina.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as financial advisor to an institutional bondholder group holding approximately US$1.9 billion of COFINA bonds in the restructuring under PROMESA.
- [BroadSpan Advises Court-Appointed Liquidators on Sale of COLFIRE](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-colfire.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the court-appointed liquidators of CL Financial on the sale of 94.24% of COLFIRE to ANSA McAL’s TATIL.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Argentina’s Province of Córdoba Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-cordoba.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the Ad Hoc Bondholder Group in the restructuring of the Province of Córdoba’s US$1.669 billion of international bonds.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Ecuador Sovereign Debt Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-ecuador.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as co-financial advisor, alongside UBS Investment Bank, to the Ecuador Steering Committee in the restructuring of Ecuador’s sovereign debt.
- [BroadSpan Advises FMO and DEG in Costa Rica Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-fmo-deg.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to development banks FMO and DEG in the restructuring and resolution of their exposure to pineapple producer Upala Agrícola.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Grenada Sovereign Debt Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-grenada.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the Steering Committee of Grenada Bondholders in the restructuring of Grenada’s sovereign debt.
- [BroadSpan Advises Grupo IMSA on Sale of NovaScott to Scott Bader](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-grupo-imsa.html): BroadSpan Capital and Mergers Alliance partner EFIC Partners advised Grupo IMSA on the sale of 50% of Nova Scott Especialidades Químicas to Scott Bader Brazil.
- [BroadSpan Advises Brazil’s Milfra on Sale to France’s Nemera](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-milfra.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Milfra, a Brazilian maker of pharmaceutical applicators and oral dosers, on its sale to France’s Nemera.
- [BroadSpan Advises Brazil’s ouronova on Strategic Equity Raise](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-ouronova.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to ouronova and its shareholders on an equity capital raise with an undisclosed international strategic investor.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders on Trinidad Petroleum Holdings Exchange Offer](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-petrotrin.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the bondholder committee in Trinidad Petroleum Holdings’ exchange offer for its bonds due 2019 and 2022.
- [BroadSpan Advises Bondholders in Puerto Rico ERS Restructuring](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-puerto-rico-ers.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to the UBS Puerto Rico Family of Funds in the restructuring of the debt of Puerto Rico’s Employees Retirement System.
- [BroadSpan Advises Brazil’s Seal Telecom on Sale to Convergint Technologies](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-seal-telecom.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Seal Telecom, a Brazilian multinational systems integrator, on its sale to Convergint Technologies.
- [BroadSpan Advises Brazil’s Servicarga on Sale to VIX Logística](https://danielochoa94.github.io/broadspan-concept/deal-servicarga.html): BroadSpan Capital acted as exclusive financial advisor to Servicarga and its shareholders on its sale to VIX Logística.
